internal/backend/agent/model/anthropic.g.1233: avoids this problem while preserving the image information itself.

internal/backend/agent/model/anthropic.g.1444: symmetric to applyOpenAIThinkingDisable in openai.go. It writes the thinking config into the body and, when disabled,
internal/backend/agent/model/anthropic.g.1445: cleans up conflicting fields, ensuring both construction paths behave consistently:
internal/backend/agent/model/anthropic.g.1446: - disabled: forces thinking:{type:"disabled"}, removes output_config / leftover thinking adaptive config,
internal/backend/agent/model/anthropic.g.1448: - adaptive: writes thinking:{type:adaptive,display:summarized} + output_config according to AnthropicThinkingEffort
